newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Magnum Petroleum buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Magnum Petroleum buy.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Friday it initiated coverage of Magnum Petroleum Inc with a buy rating.
-- Magnum, an exploration and development company, is expanding through acquisition, and is expected to continue to grow at a fast pace, ABN AMRO said.
-- ABN AMRO said it expects earnings to increase to $0.40 a share in 1997 from the $0.03 it reported in 1996.

-- "Looking ahead to 1998, the (Magnum) shares are expected to trade more in line with the multiples accorded similar companies," ABN AMRO said. "On this basis, we are setting a price target of 9-1/2 (a share), on 4.5 times 1998 projected cash flow.
